description: This bar chart illustrates accuracy evaluations for two different methods, “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval”, each with two variations: “RMU” and “RMU with Enhanced GCG”. The horizontal axis displays the evaluation method, labeled “MCQ Eval”, “RMU with Enhanced GCG”, and “Generation Eval”, in that order. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For “MCQ Eval”, there is an orange bar labeled “RMU” reaching a value of 0.644, and a light green bar labeled “RMU with Enhanced GCG” reaching a value of 0.539, with a third orange bar at 0.299. For “Generation Eval”, there is an orange bar labeled “RMU” reaching a value of 0.597, and a light green bar labeled “RMU with Enhanced GCG” reaching a value of 0.263, with a third orange bar at 0.106. The bars are grouped by evaluation method, with each group containing two bars representing the two variations of RMU. The chart includes a legend indicating that orange bars represent “RMU” and light green bars represent “RMU with Enhanced GCG”. No bars are visually emphasized.
